path.aria-label: SUPPORTED AGENCY, NOT SURVEILLANCE OR WARDEN CONTROL (wellfare-core + ingest_guardian + duty_of_inquiry) 1. Share-Houses: Equal adult peers share a Home Server / solar utility quorum (M-of-N) with ZERO guardianship over each other's vaults. 2. Families & Elderly Care: Scoped, severity-gated alerts travel over QDNF to guardians/remote carers and log to AccountabilityLedger.

path.aria-label: SEVERITY-GATED REMOTE ALERT ROUTING OVER QDNF (GuardianNotification · Severity 0 Info .. 3 Urgent) • Elderly Parent at Home (did:qi:principal:elderly-parent-at-home) -> Sanctuary Keep diary stays 100% private on Home Server (:8080) • Remote Daughter in Melbourne (Mobile Debian 13 AVF pKVM) -> Subscribed to Severity >= 1 (Notice/Concern/Urgent: Meds, Heartbeat, Falls) • Visiting Community Nurse (Remote Clinic) -> Subscribed to Severity >= 2 (Concern/Urgent) under DutyOfInquiry (Diligent vs Negligent)
path.title: SEVERITY-GATED REMOTE ALERT ROUTING OVER QDNF (GuardianNotification · Severity 0 Info .. 3 Urgent) • Elderly Parent at Home (did:qi:principal:elderly-parent-at-home) -> Sanctuary Keep diary stays 100% private on Home Server (:8080) • Remote Daughter in Melbourne (Mobile Debian 13 AVF pKVM) -> Subscribed to Severity >= 1 (Notice/Concern/Urgent: Meds, Heartbeat, Falls) • Visiting Community Nurse (Remote Clinic) -> Subscribed to Severity >= 2 (Concern/Urgent) under DutyOfInquiry (Diligent vs Negligent)

path.aria-label: TAMPER-EVIDENT ACCOUNTABILITY LEDGER & REVERSIBLE ESCALATION (48-Byte NQuin48 Receipts) [URGENT · Lv 3] Elderly Liveness Heartbeat Lapse (12h) -> Notified Daughter & Nurse over QDNF · [REVERSED: Principal tapped 'I am OK'] [CONCERN · Lv 2] Child Flagged-Content Ingest -> Notified Parent A & Escrowed Proxy Write (GuardianshipProposal M-of-N + Veto) [DENIED · Share-House Fence] Attempt to subscribe to Housemate Sam's vitals/heartbeat -> PermissionDenied (Zero Peer Guardianship)
